title: Scheduled state-mutating workflows must share a workflow-wide concurrency group
answers: scheduled stale bot runs overlapping or running at the same time
manual workflow_dispatch queued behind cron run
why does my stale or duplicate-PR workflow not serialize
concurrency group for scheduled workflows in MLflow
body:
Symptom: Overlapping runs of the scheduled stale/duplicate-PR/flaky-test bots can act on the same issues or PRs at once, and a manual dispatch can start while a cron run is still mutating state.
Root cause: .github/workflows/stale.yml, stale-prs.yml, duplicate-prs.yml and flaky-test-detector.yml used `group: ${{ github.run_id }}`, which is unique per run, so nothing ever queues.
Fix pattern: Set `concurrency.group: ${{ github.workflow }}` with `cancel-in-progress: false` so all runs of one workflow share a single queue and none are killed mid-mutation.
Constraints: Keep `cancel-in-progress: false` for these state-mutating workflows; cancelling would abort a half-finished run. Do not use run_id-based groups here. Serialization is per workflow, so a different workflow file is not blocked by these.
applies: Applies to the four scheduled, state-mutating workflow files listed above and any new cron workflow that edits issues, PRs or labels in this repo.
says: Scheduled stale issue bots run concurrently and modify the same pull requests simultaneously.
Manual runs of maintenance workflows collide with active scheduled jobs updating labels.
Queue duplicate pull request cleanup jobs instead of letting simultaneous executions conflict.
Prevent scheduled repository automation from terminating mid-run when another execution is triggered.
Flaky test detector runs overlap and corrupt shared state across open issues.
search: Scheduled state-mutating workflows must configure concurrency.group to github.workflow with cancel-in-progress set to false. This serializes cron runs and manual workflow_dispatch triggers in .github/workflows/stale.yml, stale-prs.yml, duplicate-prs.yml, flaky-test-detector.yml, and any new workflow mutating issues, PRs, or labels. Run_id-based groups must not be used because they prevent queuing, and cancel-in-progress must remain false to avoid aborting runs mid-mutation.
